prompt: A lean human rogue in a dark indigo hooded cloak crouches over a fresh grave in a moonlit cemetery, prying a glowing wax-sealed scroll free from a skeletal hand reaching up from the dirt. The stolen scroll glows cold cerulean. He glances back over his shoulder, caught mid-theft. The background is a black-blue night graveyard with crooked headstones and a low fog, the only light the cerulean glow of the scroll and a sliver of moon.

Close-up of a thiefs gloved hand snatching a luminous violet soul-letter, a folded parchment bound with a glowing wax seal, out of the open chest of a slain armored soldier lying in the dirt. Wine-purple necromantic light leaks from the wound. The rogue, in a black-blue cloak, is half-visible at the edge crouched low. The background is dark battlefield mud at night, faint cerulean mist, the only light the violet glow of the stolen seal.

A hooded human courier-rogue sprints south-west across rooftops at night, fleeing, clutching a satchel from which spills a glowing sealed scroll trailing cerulean and wine-purple wisps like stolen ghosts. His indigo cloak streams behind him. The background is a moonlit medieval city skyline of dark slate rooftops against a deep blue-black sky, the only light the cold glow of the loot he carries.

A rogue in a deep indigo hood kneels in a crypt and lifts a glowing signet ring and a wax-sealed letter from the bony grip of a corpse laid on a stone slab. The dead grave-goods glow ghostly cerulean as he steals them. His face is shadowed, a sly grin. The background is a dim black-blue stone crypt with carved sarcophagi, the only light the cold cerulean glow of the stolen seal.

Worms-eye view from inside an open grave looking up: a hooded thiefs silhouette reaches down toward the camera, gloved fingers closing on a glowing wax-sealed scroll resting on a shrouded corpses chest. The seal glows cold cerulean, underlighting his shadowed grinning face. The background is the black-blue night sky and grave-edge dirt framing him, the only light the cerulean glow of the seal.

A human rogue in a dark indigo cloak stands in side profile facing south-east on a foggy battlefield at night, having just stabbed a soldier; with his free gloved hand he plucks a glowing wax-sealed letter from the dying soldiers belt as the man crumples. The stolen letter glows cerulean. The background is a dark blue-black battlefield of fallen bodies and broken spears under a thin moon, the only light the cerulean glow of the seal.

A grinning human rogue in a deep blue hood holds up a stolen glowing card, a luminous wax-sealed playing-card-shaped token, between two fingers toward the viewer like a magician revealing a trick, having just lifted it from an open grave at his feet. Cerulean and wine-purple light spills from the card across his face. The background is a black-blue night cemetery with leaning headstones and fog, the only light the glow of the stolen card.

A lean masked courier-rogue in indigo leather crouches low beside a fallen knight on dark cobblestones, slipping a glowing wax-sealed scroll from the dead knights gauntlet into his own satchel. He looks back toward the viewer warily. The stolen scroll glows cold cerulean. The background is a narrow black-blue night alley lit by a single hanging lantern and the cerulean glow of the loot.

A hooded rogue in a wine-purple and indigo cloak kneels at a freshly dug grave at night and pulls a glowing soul-card upward out of the dead mans chest, a luminous rectangular sigil-card trailing wisps of cerulean light as it tears free. His grin is underlit. The background is a dark blue-black graveyard, crooked crosses, low fog, the only light the cerulean glow of the rising card.

A confident human rogue in a dark indigo hood walks toward the viewer down a moonlit graveyard path, tucking a glowing wax-sealed scroll into his cloak with a sly grin, leaving an open robbed grave behind him. The scroll glows cerulean from inside his coat. The background is a deep blue-black cemetery with rows of pale headstones and bare trees under a full moon, fog at his boots, moonlight haloing his hood.
